name: Shop
author: Elvin
description: A fully asynchronous shop cog with buttons, modals, Red’s bank integration, inventory management, and role purchases.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing the Shop cog!  
• Use `[p]shop manage` to create or edit your shops.  
• Use `[p]shop addstock <shop>`, `[p]shop addrole <shop> <@role> <price>` to configure stock.  
• Users can run `[p]buy`, `[p]gift`, and `[p]redeem` to interact via buttons and modals.  
Make sure Red’s Bank cog is enabled so the economy features work properly.
